# ADONI KAYA (અડોણી કાયા)

ADONI KAYA is a free Gujarati-language online memorial card creation platform.

Primary website:
https://adonikaya.github.io/ADONI_KAYA/

Primary services:
- Gujarati Shradhanjali cards
- Gujarati Besna cards
- Gujarati memorial and invitation card templates
- Browser-based PNG, JPG, and PDF exports

Public pages:
- About: https://adonikaya.github.io/ADONI_KAYA/about/
- Shradhanjali maker: https://adonikaya.github.io/ADONI_KAYA/shradhanjali-maker/
- Besna maker: https://adonikaya.github.io/ADONI_KAYA/besna-card-maker/
- Template gallery: https://adonikaya.github.io/ADONI_KAYA/gallery/
- Privacy policy: https://adonikaya.github.io/ADONI_KAYA/privacy-policy/
